label: Peplink UBR LTE industrial SD-WAN router
description: Peplink UBR LTE - fanless, DIN-mount industrial SD-WAN router with 1x Gigabit WAN, 4x Gigabit LAN, and two embedded LTE modems with two SIM slots for SpeedFusion bonding. Terminal-block power, -40 to 65 C operating range, InControl management; PrimeCare bundles the SpeedFusion licences.
notes: The page gives the copper as text - '1x Gigabit WAN port, 4X Gigabit LAN port' - so the split is quoted. The two embedded LTE modems with two SIM slots are the reason this box exists, and they are modelled as `wwan0`/`wwan1`, which is this catalogue's name for a cellular WAN (compare Balance 20X): they are WAN bearers with no connector, so they cannot be cabled in a lab, but hiding them entirely would make a triple-WAN SpeedFusion topology look like a single-WAN router. The page does not publish an LTE category, so the 100M on those two ports is the catalogue's neutral default for an unquoted cellular bearer, not a quoted rate. Power is a terminal block with Molex connectors - no PSU in the box and no PoE anywhere, which is why no `poeIn` appears on any port. There is no Wi-Fi on this model, so no `wireless` capability is declared despite the two wwan interfaces.
